== Acquisition ==
{{Sold by}}

== Recipes ==
The Mystic Binding Agent is used to [[Mystic Forge#Rare crafting materials|promote]] [[Crafting material#Rare crafting materials|rare crafting materials]], in order to "batch" a number of promotions together into one promotion. The Mystic Binding Agent replaces the [[Bottle of Elonian Wine]] in the regular rare material promotion recipe. The batched recipe allows you to combine 8 slivers into 4 fragments, 6 fragments into 3 shards, 4 shards into 2 cores, or 2 cores into 1 lodestone, where as the original recipe would produce 2 to 1 on all tiers. The batched recipe still will only take a single dust and a single crystal.
{{Recipe list by discipline}}
